text:
[issue by budgej]
### Describe the bug

I accidentally placed a proxy block from the CapabilityProxy mod facing a dense ME cable.  The server ran fine until its next restart.  The next time it started, the world crashed immediately upon load, due to "IllegalArgumentException: Cannot connect node to itself"

### How to reproduce the bug

Place a proxy block facing a live network cable.  Save the game and reload.

### Expected behavior

Nothing should happen.  The cable should reject the connection but not crash the server.

### Additional details

This may be the fault of the CapabilityProxy mod, but in case another block ends up doing something similar, perhaps AE's handling of this very specific and unlikely situation could be handled by either deleting the erroring cable, or blocking the connection.

I will also report this to the CapabilityProxy devs, perhaps they can blacklist ME cables.

### Which minecraft version are you using?

1.21.1

### On which mod loaders does it happen?

NeoForge 21.1.209

### Crash log

https://pastebin.com/gXCfB0yx

[comment by Technici4n (member)]
We should be marking the capability as not proxyable already, so Capability Proxy should respect that.
